signatureHelp.scenario: signature help inside a call on .law
signatureHelp.reason: Server-only capability: the extension has no JavaScript signature provider, so there is nothing to compare and no ownership to transfer. law-lsp answers textDocument/signatureHelp from the compiler index (call span, argument slots, parameter labels); the client registers it whenever the server starts. A std term call answers from its generated dictionary card (call form and parameter descriptions) through the compiler slots `stdCalls`. A call the index does not cover returns the signature without an active parameter.
signatureHelp.evidence: cd engines/lawc && cargo test -p law-lsp signature

inspection.scenario: inspect a kept run of one .lawtest test
inspection.reason: Server-only capability (DECISION-0449 P1): the extension has no JavaScript counterpart. `law.inspectRun` evaluates one test of an open .lawtest on the VFS snapshot of the request, keeps the run (document, exact program snapshot, editor index and the law.inspection-bundle/0.1 binding them) in a bounded store and returns its id; `law.inspect` answers the law-inspect projection (summary, slice, diff, locate) over the run named by id, evaluates nothing, and checks the current bytes of the authored files, open buffers included, before a jump. The existing law.runScenario/law.explain/law.whyNot/law.proof are unchanged.
